"Elite status strengthens our commitment to helping clients harness the full value of their data and build enterprise-ready AI on Snowflake." Ready to start your Snowflake journey with an Elite Partner? [Get in touch](/contact).

news.excerpt: The founder story behind Viewnear's rapid rise — from a small specialist team to a Snowflake Elite Partner serving the Americas in four years.
news.body:
Achieving Snowflake Elite Partner status in four years does not happen by accident. This is the story behind the milestone: the decision to go all-in on Snowflake and the AI Data Cloud, the investment in community and education, and the delivery philosophy that underpins everything Viewnear does.

The founders started with a simple conviction — that there is no AI strategy without a data strategy — and a bet on a single platform. Rather than spreading thin across every cloud and tool, Viewnear committed early to building genuinely deep Snowflake expertise, pairing it with a focused ecosystem of Matillion, dbt, ThoughtSpot, Sigma, and Power BI. That focus compounded. Each engagement across financial services, healthcare, retail, and agriculture added pattern knowledge that made the next delivery faster, cleaner, and more repeatable.

The second ingredient was community. From hosting regional Snowflake user groups to publishing hands-on technical content and running AI labs, Viewnear has consistently invested in growing the broader data community across the Americas — not just shipping client work. That "give first" philosophy built trust with practitioners, partners, and Snowflake itself, and it is reflected in recognitions that extend beyond commercial performance.

"Elite status is the result of doing the unglamorous things consistently — being honest with clients, investing in our people, and shipping platforms that actually get used," said Jordan Mendez, Director of Strategy & Partnerships. "What started as a small specialist team is now an Elite Partner serving organisations from Canada to LATAM. The mission hasn't changed: help clients turn data into their greatest competitive advantage, and build the internal capability that keeps them ahead long after we've delivered."

news.excerpt: A Viewnear director has been named a Snowflake Data Superhero, recognising sustained contribution to the data community and technical leadership across the Americas.
news.body:
A Viewnear director has been recognised as a **Snowflake Data Superhero**, one of fewer than 200 practitioners worldwide chosen each year for outstanding contributions to community building, knowledge sharing, technical education, and AI enablement. The recognition reflects work that goes well beyond day-to-day delivery — content creation, training, user-group leadership, public speaking, and a consistent commitment to helping others get more from the Snowflake AI Data Cloud.

The Data Superhero programme is sometimes described as the equivalent of being a Snowflake influencer, but the recognition is about more than technology. It rewards practitioners who are authentic about helping build community, who share their experience openly, and who champion change. Over the past two years, the work behind this honour has helped grow the regional Snowflake community across the Americas — bringing together students, engineers, data leaders, and executives in a space built for collaboration and learning.

The community philosophy is simple: give first. You can't ask people to engage before you've offered something of value — it is a bit like paying it forward. That principle has shaped Viewnear's investment in AI labs, user groups, training, enablement, and mentoring, with a growing focus on practical AI engineering, AI SQL, and real-world adoption of Snowflake's AI capabilities.

"Being recognised as a Data Superhero is a great feeling, because it recognises the effort that goes into building a community," the recipient said. "We're passionate about what we do, not just the technology itself — and we believe the Americas have an enormous opportunity to lead in data and AI when we grow local skills alongside the platforms."

news.excerpt: At an executive roundtable in Toronto, Viewnear brought financial services leaders together to explore AI readiness, data foundations, and the practical steps from ambition to implementation.
news.body:
Viewnear convened senior financial services leaders in **Toronto** for an executive roundtable on AI and data strategy. The session explored the challenges and opportunities facing the sector as organisations modernise their data platforms and prepare for AI-driven transformation — and it focused squarely on the practical steps needed to move from ambition to implementation.

A Viewnear director led an interactive discussion on the data and AI challenges specific to financial services, with practical sessions on Snowflake Cortex and governed AI. A clear theme emerged from the room: while AI is high on every executive agenda, many organisations are still working to strengthen the data foundations required to deliver meaningful AI outcomes. As one participant put it, AI is only as good as the data you feed it.

The conversation ranged across data foundations, AI readiness, customer-experience transformation, governance, breaking down silos, operational efficiency, and executive alignment. Leaders shared candid lessons from complex transformations — including the insight that a clear North Star vision and tactical quick wins are not mutually exclusive, and that data harmony is less a one-off technical fix than something embedded into company culture.

The agenda opened with breakfast and a keynote, *There is no AI strategy without a data strategy*, followed by a panel on AI in financial services. For Viewnear, roundtables like this matter because they create space for honest, practical conversation about what it actually takes to unlock value from data and AI — the kind of peer exchange that rarely happens in a vendor pitch.

news.excerpt: Viewnear hosted a healthcare data collaboration workshop, shifting the conversation from data monetisation to data value realisation through secure, governed sharing on Snowflake.
news.body:
Viewnear hosted a **healthcare data collaboration workshop** bringing together providers, insurers, and data leaders to explore how the healthcare ecosystem can collaborate more effectively around data. The healthcare landscape across the Americas holds enormously valuable information — claims, pharmacy transactions, wellness signals, and clinical outcomes — and the workshop reframed the opportunity from data monetisation alone to a broader idea: **data value realisation**.

The central theme was that responsible data collaboration can drive shared value across the ecosystem: improving decision-making, creating richer context for AI and machine learning, and ultimately supporting better patient outcomes and a lower cost of care. Viewnear demonstrated what secure data collaboration looks like in practice, and the discussion explored how organisations can share responsibly while meeting the non-negotiable requirements of healthcare data — governance, privacy, compliance, consent, and clean rooms. These cannot be treated separately; together they are what make collaboration ethical, legal, and durable.

Snowflake provides the platform capabilities that make secure collaboration possible, with a focus on data that is easy, trusted, and connected. The workshop walked through the relevant building blocks — data clean rooms, data masking, row-level security, privacy policies, secure data sharing, the Snowflake Marketplace, and Snowgrid — showing how regulated organisations can exchange insight without ever exposing raw, sensitive records.

The session reinforced a simple conclusion: data itself is an asset, and AI needs collaboration to reach its full potential. The future of healthcare analytics will belong to organisations that make a clear connection between collaboration, patient outcomes, and a more efficient system. For Viewnear, the event reflected our core approach — combining strategic advisory with hands-on technical implementation to help organisations move from data potential to practical value.

news.excerpt: Viewnear has expanded its operations to better serve clients across Canada, the USA, Mexico, LATAM, and the Caribbean.
news.body:
Viewnear has expanded its operations across the Americas, deepening its ability to serve clients in **Canada, the USA, Mexico, LATAM, and the Caribbean**. The expansion is driven by strong, sustained demand for cost-effective data and AI delivery, particularly from mid-market and enterprise organisations that remain strategically committed to transformation but are increasingly focused on measurable outcomes and value for money.

The Americas market is broad and varied in its cloud maturity. In more mature markets, Snowflake already enjoys a strong presence, and conversations are less about platform capability and more about delivery, execution, and proof. In faster-growing markets, the opportunity is to help organisations leapfrog legacy patterns and build modern, AI-ready foundations from the start. Viewnear's model meets clients where they are: local relationships and account management close to the customer, backed by a deep, cross-regional delivery bench.

That regional footprint gives Viewnear several advantages — time-zone alignment across North and Latin America, multilingual and English-speaking delivery teams, strong technical depth, and a cost-effective implementation model that lets clients do more with their data budget. With teams spanning Toronto, the USA, and Mexico City, work can follow the client rather than the other way around.

As an Elite Partner and Authorised Reseller, Viewnear pairs this expanded reach with end-to-end capability: strategy, cloud architecture, data engineering, analytics, and AI delivered in-house by a single accountable team. The expansion is about more than geography — it is about bringing the full Snowflake stack, and a genuine local presence, to every client across the region.

news.excerpt: At Snowflake Summit, Viewnear hosted a regional user group session, bringing data leaders together for honest conversation about production patterns and lessons learned on the AI Data Cloud.
news.body:
At **Snowflake Summit**, Viewnear hosted a regional user group session, bringing together data leaders, engineers, architects, and partners from across the Americas for an hour of networking and open conversation around AI, data, and the future of the Snowflake ecosystem. It was a community gathering rather than a formal presentation — no slides, no pitch, just honest exchange between practitioners who build on Snowflake every day.

The session was designed to be conversational and accessible. Attendees swapped real patterns and lessons from production deployments: what works and what doesn't in AI adoption, how to build the business case for AI on Snowflake, and how modern data platforms create genuine competitive differentiation. Whether participants were exploring AI transformation, scaling an existing platform, or simply looking to connect with peers and the wider Snowflake community, the room was built for it.

User groups like this sit at the heart of how Viewnear engages with the community. We believe you have to give before you can receive, and gatherings at Summit are where that philosophy plays out at scale — connecting chapter leaders, Data Superheroes, customers, and partners, and surfacing the kind of candid, practitioner-level insight that rarely makes it into a keynote.

For Viewnear, hosting at Summit is both a contribution and a commitment: a way of helping grow the regional Snowflake community across Canada, the USA, Mexico, LATAM, and the Caribbean, and of staying close to where the platform — and the people building on it — are heading next.
